note: Every expectation here was checked against canon sources, not against what the engine happened to return. Three of these were wrong at the time of writing: Hunter ranks answered on the wrong axis, the Royal Guards came back as all 64 Chimera Ants, and the Phantom Troupe contained Omokage, an original character from the non-canon film Phantom Rouge.

questions.question: Every Chimera Ant Royal Guard
questions.note: Three. Hunterpedia's `Royal Guards` page names them in prose only, so asking by category returned all 64 Chimera Ants.

questions.question: Every Hunter rank
questions.note: The star licences. This used to answer Provisional / Unclassified / Amateur, which is employment status.

questions.question: Every member of the Phantom Troupe
questions.note: Omokage is from Phantom Rouge, which is not canon. Hunterpedia files that film under `anime debut`, so only the debut target's page type — `movie` — reveals it.
